code:
Hardware
  -> Hypervisor (ESXi / Hyper-V / KVM / Xen)
     -> VM1 / VM2 / VM3
caption: Installs directly on the hardware. No host OS competing for CPU or memory.

code:
Hardware
  -> Host OS (Windows / macOS / Linux)
     -> Hypervisor app (VirtualBox / Workstation)
        -> VM1 / VM2
caption: An application on top of a regular OS. Fine for a laptop, not for production.
